SELECT DISTINCT c.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, c.course_code AS courseCode, c.classification AS classification, c.credit AS credit, c.created_at AS createdAt, sch.teacher_id AS teacherId, u.username AS teacherName, sch.week_day AS weekDay, sch.start_period AS startPeriod, sch.end_period AS endPeriod, cr.classroom_name AS classroomName, cap.max_capacity AS maxCapacity, cap.current_count AS currentCount FROM course c LEFT JOIN schedule sch ON c.course_id = sch.course_id LEFT JOIN classroom cr ON sch.classroom_id = cr.classroom_id LEFT JOIN course_capacity cap ON c.course_id = cap.course_id LEFT JOIN user u ON sch.teacher_id = u.user_id
AND c.classification = #{query.classification}
AND c.course_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')
AND c.course_code = #{query.keyword}
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')
AND (c.course_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR c.course_code = #{query.keyword})
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

SELECT c.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, c.course_code AS courseCode, c.classification AS classification, c.credit AS credit, c.weekly_frequency AS weeklyFrequency, c.is_active AS isActive, sch.schedule_id AS scheduleId, sch.week_day AS weekDay, sch.start_period AS startPeriod, sch.end_period AS endPeriod, cr.classroom_id AS classroomId, cr.classroom_name AS classroomName, cap.capacity_id AS capacityId, cap.max_capacity AS maxCapacity, cap.current_count AS currentCount, sch.teacher_id AS teacherId, u.username AS teacherName FROM course c INNER JOIN course_capacity cap ON c.course_id = cap.course_id AND cap.semester = #{semester} LEFT JOIN schedule sch ON c.course_id = sch.course_id AND sch.semester = #{semester} LEFT JOIN classroom cr ON sch.classroom_id = cr.classroom_id LEFT JOIN user u ON sch.teacher_id = u.user_id ORDER BY c.course_id
